title: Metal Hydride Phase Transformation Mechanism Using In-situ S/TEM
content: Hydrogen is a promising zero-emission fuel and energy storage medium; however, compact and safe storage remains a critical challenge. Metal hydrides offer a viable solution, but optimizing their storage properties requires an in-depth understanding of metal-to-metal hydride phase transformations. Real-time visualization of phase transformations and their mechanisms of hydrogen absorption and desorption is essential for improving and advancing hydrogen storage materials [1].
